families.summary: Low-volume HEAD probes for OSS path predictability: confirm YYYY-MM/random-name layout, check common sensitive filenames, and map which monthly directories exist via 403/404 oracle.
families.title: OSS object-storage path predictability probe

safe_actions: single benign replay per selected endpoint
families.summary: Compare benign boundary values for input type, quote escaping, parser errors, and status/body-shape deltas.
families.title: Input encoding and error-difference probe

families.summary: Check non-mutating method handling, content-type mismatch, missing auth-header shape, and safe OPTIONS metadata.
families.title: Method, Content-Type, and auth-header boundary probe

safe_actions: no cross-user object reads without explicit gate
families.summary: Look for ID/status/retry hints using known benign requests; block before reading sensitive records or changing state.
families.title: ID, state, and duplicate-submit shape probe

families.summary: Inspect CORS/Origin/Host response metadata with benign origins and no credential exfiltration.
families.title: CORS, Origin, and Host trust-boundary probe

families.summary: Plan low-volume discovery for file/export/debug/config signals already present in collected URLs or summaries.
families.title: File, export, debug, and config exposure discovery

safe_actions: never fetch real file bodies or enumerate directories
families.summary: Low-volume shape probe on a gateway noToken whitelist fileDownload endpoint: param-name enumeration, method and Content-Type variants, response-shape differences (empty body/error/redirect/Content-Disposition). No real file reads.
families.title: noToken whitelist file-download shape probe

gate_triggers: credential attempt or account enumeration signal
safe_actions: never attempt credentials, weak passwords, or enumeration
families.summary: Low-volume shape probe on an external (outer) login endpoint: JSON type-juggling, parameter-name and Content-Type variants, root non-object/batch/malformed shapes, and response-shape differences. No credential enumeration, guessing, or brute force.
families.title: External auth2 login endpoint shape probe

safe_actions: schema/introspection requires local rules and operator gate if target policy is unclear
families.summary: Check whether already discovered API docs, GraphQL endpoints, Swagger, source maps, or chunks need scoped follow-up.
families.title: API, GraphQL, Swagger, and source-map surface probe

families.summary: Any weak password, brute force, lockout, MFA, or account-boundary test requires operator approval.
families.title: Weak-password or authentication-boundary probe

families.summary: Mutation, deletion, upload, purchase, workflow transition, concurrency, and load probes must not run automatically.
families.title: State-changing, destructive, concurrent, or high-load probe
